content.title: Order Limiting maximum Sentence
content.summary: Effective January 6, 2026, no sentence for a criminal ordinance violation in Arvada shall exceed the maximum allowed by state law for similar misdemeanors or petty offenses. For violations without a state equivalent, the maximum penalty remains 364 days in jail and/or a fine of $2,650. This order aims to ensure the efficient administration of justice in the City of Arvada.
content.body:
## Presiding Judge Order 2026-01  City of Arvada Municipal Court  Effective January 6, 2026

No sentence imposed under the Arvada Municipal Code for a criminal ordinance violation shall exceed the maximum sentence permitted by state law for an equivalent misdemeanor or petty offense under Title 18, C.R.S. See, In re People v. Camp, 2025 CO 65 (Colo. 2025). The maximum sentence for all other criminal ordinance violations for which there is no state equivalent offense under title 18, C.R.S. remains 364 days in jail and/or a fine of $2,650.00.

The Court finds that these Orders are appropriate and necessary to the efficient and effective administration of justice in the City of Arvada.

**Dated and effective this 6th day of January, 2026.**

**By the Court:**

**Kathryn Kurtz  
Presiding Judge  
City of Arvada Municipal Court**
